home.title: ArGeles — Artisan jellies, made to order
home.description: Hand-moulded jellies decorated with fresh fruit, made for the date of your celebration. Choose your piece and order it on WhatsApp.

links.title: ArGeles — Links
links.description: Message us on WhatsApp, visit the website or download the PDF price list.

hero.headline: Delicacy in every layer
hero.body: Hand-moulded and finished with fresh fruit. Each piece is made for the date of your celebration: weddings, christenings, birthdays and dessert tables.

orders.statement: Orders are taken at least three days ahead.

notes.fruit: Every jelly is made to order, with selected fresh fruit.
notes.flavours: The flavours and the fruit of every piece can be adapted to your taste.
notes.deposit: A deposit reserves your order: 50% on large pieces, with the rest paid on the day of delivery.
notes.delivery: Large jellies are delivered in their box; individual portions with a lid and a spoon.
notes.currency: Prices in US dollars. Payments in bolívares follow the day's BCV rate.

section.title: Catalogue
section.subtitle: Every piece is made to order with selected fresh fruit. Choose yours and order it on WhatsApp.

hints.pickAny: Pick as many as you like

encapsulada-de-frutas.name: Encapsulated Fruit
encapsulada-de-frutas.note: Fresh fruit in clear jelly over tres leches
encapsulada-de-frutas.description: Fresh fruit of your choice suspended in a layer of clear jelly, over a base of tres leches jelly.
encapsulada-de-frutas.imageAlt: Clear jelly crown with strawberries, purple grapes, peach and green grapes

napolitana-de-frutas.name: Neapolitan Fruit
napolitana-de-frutas.note: Sliced fruit over fruit stripes and tres leches
napolitana-de-frutas.description: Sliced fresh fruit over fine stripes of fruit-flavoured jelly of your choice and tres leches jelly.
napolitana-de-frutas.imageAlt: Rectangular jelly with red, white and green layers, sliced strawberries on top

corona-tres-leches.name: Tres Leches Crown
corona-tres-leches.note: Fruit flavour and tres leches in a ring mould
corona-tres-leches.description: Fruit-flavoured jelly of your choice and tres leches jelly alternating in a ring mould.
corona-tres-leches.imageAlt: Flower-mould jelly, red on top and cream below, on a gold board

bicolor-coronada.name: Crowned Two-Tone
bicolor-coronada.note: Two tones of fruit, crowned with fresh fruit
bicolor-coronada.description: Fruit-flavoured jelly of your choice in two tones, one intense and one with condensed milk, crowned with fresh fruit.
bicolor-coronada.imageAlt: Fluted jelly mould, dark purple over a lilac layer, with grapes at the centre

mosaico-de-fruta-fresca.name: Fresh Fruit Mosaic
mosaico-de-fruta-fresca.note: Fruit cubes over stripes with condensed milk
mosaico-de-fruta-fresca.description: Fresh fruit cubes in the top layer and stripes of fruit-flavoured jelly with condensed milk.
mosaico-de-fruta-fresca.imageAlt: Round scalloped pink jelly with strawberry cubes in its clear top layer

cristal-y-crema.name: Crystal and Cream
cristal-y-crema.note: One clear layer and one creamy base
cristal-y-crema.description: Fruit-flavoured jelly of your choice in two layers, one clear and a creamy base with condensed milk.
cristal-y-crema.imageAlt: Red jelly in a round pearl mould on a white plate

porcion-individual.name: Individual Portion
porcion-individual.note: With a lid and a spoon, ready to serve
porcion-individual.description: A creamy fruit-flavoured jelly base, fresh fruit cubes and a jelly flower. Ready to serve, with its lid and spoon.
porcion-individual.imageAlt: Lidded individual cups of strawberry jelly with fruit cubes and a pink flower on top
